classification: Icarus accepts nested virtual-interface child handles and method calls but rejects direct procedural lvalue writes through a child of virtual chip_if; IEEE 1800-2017/2023 §25.9 and strict Slang accept the source. Six exact-typed child VIF aliases are a disposable workaround while the compiler lvalue path lacks nested-interface receiver support.

minimal_reducers.diagnostic: Both Icarus editions reject only the direct nested lvalue, reporting `Class parent_if does not have a property child`; Slang 2017/2023 accepts it with zero warnings. Both Icarus editions compile and run the child-alias and exact-parameterized controls, with PASS markers and physical-child readback; Slang accepts both controls with zero warnings.

source_overlay.scope: Declare and bind six exact-typed child VIF aliases after chip_vif is retrieved; use them for the 40 direct lvalue writes in eight sequences. Nested reads and calls remain untouched.
